links.outcome: Precision and recall of sleep staging under synthetic input noise, with vs without smoothing
links.effect: Under low and high synthetic noise (σ > 0.2), smoothed outputs retain 10–15% higher precision and recall across all stages.
links.quote: Smoothing improves generalization and robustness: under both low and high synthetic noise (  σ > 0.2), smoothed outputs retain 10–15% higher precision and recall across all stages.

links.outcome: Effect of postprocessing control logic on stage-prediction precision and suppression of implausible transitions
links.effect: Hybrid control logic achieved 80% (Wake), 96% (N2), 98% (N3), 86% (REM) precision; a transition constraint matrix suppresses biologically implausible transitions.
links.quote: Control logic further enhances reliability: our hybrid method achieves 80% (Wake), 96% (N2), 98% (N3), and 86% (REM) precision.
